candidates.description: This vector represents substances, consumables, and raw materials, with a strong emphasis on botanical and psychoactive products.
Chemical prefixes, functional groups, and biochemistry-related word roots.
This feature represents medical, biological, and pharmacological processes related to physiological effects, symptoms, and treatments.
This vector represents adverbial and nominal suffixes, primarily in Romance languages, associated with manner, state, or action.
This vector represents biological and medical terms related to the nervous system and neurology.
This vector represents temporal and logical transition adverbs and connectors across multiple languages.
The tokens relate to the consumption, ingestion, or processing of substances and materials, spanning multiple languages.
This vector is related to conjugated Spanish auxiliary and modal verbs indicating necessity, ability, or state.
This feature activates on the root morphemes or stems of Latin-ate or Romance-derived verbs and nouns, particularly those related to technical, academic, or systematic processes.
This vector represents psychological and behavioral states related to impulse, consciousness, and volition.
